notes: This R100B authority refines stochastic ray/sample and receiver-estimator budget without changing the frozen R100A-2 fixture.
Each refinement level increases ray count while reducing receiver radius and histogram-bin width; all required sample times are shared across levels.
Same-seed deterministic replay is a separate prerequisite and is not statistical convergence.
Statistical convergence uses independent seeds at every refinement level and retains seed-to-seed variation.
The R100A-2 observable tolerance remains authoritative; this file does not add or relax pass tolerances.
A sample with insufficient positive cumulative ray energy is recorded as insufficient_support and is never converted to a zero response.
